answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the nadir of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The beacon holds work receipts rather than names, so the grove of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
